name: docs-sync-guard
description: PreToolUse git-commit gate against docs drift in plugins/ monorepos — denies a commit that changes a plugin's executable code (scripts/hooks/agents/workflows) without staging that plugin's README.md or CLAUDE.md. Tests, version bumps, and skills/commands markdown never trigger it; add docs-sync:ack to the commit message for deliberate no-doc-impact changes.
